answer: Divergence nonce requirement. Each identity must, in a fresh round, derive a unique path from a common start using a private nonce and persist that path’s state. Any two identities whose prefixes match through the canyon checkpoint are rejected. Passing requires forking separate nonce state per clone; copying or resetting state yields a matching spiral signature. Cost: one dedicated nonce store and per-round recomputation per identity, so N clones need N independent state forks and memory. A plume of identical paths is blocked at registration.
